card: Backports PR #36927 to the 30.x maintenance branch and updates the release notes for v30.x. It removes CMake -Werror=dev flags and dev-error preset settings to prevent developer warnings from breaking CI and local developer builds on stable maintenance releases. Evidence comes directly from the upstream fix merged in #36927 for the 30.6 milestone.
evidence: Commit df0d358c51 and 9006b9cb16 backport #36927 ('build: remove *dev* errors from dev-mode'), which was already merged on newer branches to prevent CMake warning breakages.
problem: Treating CMake developer warnings as hard errors in developer mode and CI causes build breaks when newer CMake versions or updated environments introduce new deprecation or developer warnings on a stable release branch.

risk.why: Mistakes only affect developer preset configurations and CI invocations for CMake warnings on a maintenance branch, without touching runtime node code.

scope_notes: The git merge base diff shows drift from the main development branch across many files, but the PR itself consists solely of three commits backporting #36927 and updating release notes (+3/-3 lines across 4 files).
summary: Backports pull request #36927 to the 30.x maintenance branch and updates the v30.x release notes. The change removes CMake developer warnings as errors (`-Werror=dev` and dev errors preset) from developer-mode build presets and CI.
